note: Detection rules over the audit trail of agent actions (ADR-022). Each rule keeps a behavioural baseline per identity from a 28-day window and is evaluated every 5 minutes. In production the window rolls daily and leaves out activity that raised an alert until a person has reviewed it; Lab 14.1 uses one fixed window. Deploying them in the log pipeline, with paging, is Chapter 16's work; Lab 14.1 evaluates them offline.

rules.title: Export burst
rules.response: trip the kill switch automatically, then page the security on-call

rules.title: Identity seen from a network it has not used before
rules.response: page the security on-call; trip the kill switch if the owner does not recognise the network

rules.title: Read volume
rules.response: trip the kill switch automatically, then page the security on-call

rules.title: Break-glass session started
rules.response: page the security lead; the session is reviewed within one working day
